title: JUKI MO-6816S
subtitle: 5-Thread Overlock / Safety Stitch Machine (MO-6800S Series)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI MO-6816S is a 5-thread overlock / safety stitch machine belonging to the JUKI MO-6800S series. It combines a 2-needle overedge with an additional safety-stitch thread, producing a wide, strong, stretchable seam with a finished edge in a single pass — typically used for seaming medium to heavy-weight woven and knit fabrics.
applications: Seaming and overedging medium to heavy-weight woven fabrics in a single pass
Seaming knit fabrics (T-shirts, polo shirts, sportswear, underwear)
Wide safety-stitch seams on jeans, workwear, and uniform assembly
Operations requiring a 5-thread combination stitch (overedge + lockstitch)
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (woven and knit), jeans production, workwear and uniform manufacturing, sportswear production

overviewDescription: The JUKI MO-6816S is a 5-thread overlock / safety stitch machine from the MO-6800S series. It uses two needles, an upper looper, a lower looper, and an additional chain-stitch thread to form a 5-thread safety / overedge combination in one pass. The machine runs at up to 7,000 sti/min with differential feed (1:2 max 1:4 gathering; 1:0.7 max 1:0.6 stretching) and a 24.5 mm needle bar stroke. The 60H sub-type uses a 27.0 mm needle bar stroke. The head is lubricated automatically with JUKI Machine Oil 18 (ISO VG18).

finalNotes:
• The MO-6816S is the 5-thread variant in the MO-6800S series; its sister model JUKI MO-6816D (a 2-needle / 4-thread safety-stitch / interlock head) is already catalogued separately on this site.
• The 60H sub-type variant uses a longer needle bar stroke (27.0 mm vs 24.5 mm) for heavier fabrics.
• Phase 1 PASS — Tier-1 Juki catalog PDF + instruction manual confirms 7,000 sti/min, 0.6–3.8 mm stitch length, DC×27 needle, 24.5 mm needle bar stroke, 20° inclination.
